new_value: Fixed in 2a7e025. Verified empirically rather than by inspection: with the build script unchanged and the build settled, 'touch proto/spiffe/workload/workload.proto && cargo build -p persona-grpc' produced NO work before the fix (Finished, nothing compiled) and recompiles persona-grpc after it. The proto list and include root are each named once and used for both the rerun-if-changed directives and compile_protos, so the trigger cannot drift from the compiler input. Note build artifacts land in /home/mark/Cache/cargo-target per ~/.cargo/config.toml, not ./target.
